answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI agent to reserve 1,000 credits for a unique service slot, ensuring the network acts as a lush orchard of verified participants. A global verifier monitors the ledger to reject any double-committed accounts, which would reveal themselves like a reflection in a broken mirror. While an honest agent pays 1,000 credits, a sybil farm attempting 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 credit penalty. Evidence of fraud triggers a 180-day lock on funds, applying a velvet touch of strict finality to all malfeasance.
